description: This reference locates solenoid-valve nc auxiliary contact in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented solenoids family. This form identifies a normally-closed auxiliary contact associated with a solenoid valve. The public library uses HSV22 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
